posts.title: Non Zürich?
posts.description: Let’s explore the question: when applying to new positions, should I just apply to Zurich instead of all of Switzerland? It has been ~3 months since I started applying. This reflection comes because I got an interview from Basel a few days ago, and one of the first things I thought was “it’s way too close to the German border”. Here we go again with this mindset of diversification to slowly grind
